prose.name: Rescue: Medevac at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A worker at the <Place> broke his leg and needs walking out to a ship. The crew can't spare anyone.
prose.card: Local Contract. Escort an injured worker from the <Place> on <Planet> to a waiting ship. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Find the injured worker at the <Place>

person.name: Tobin Ashgrove
hellos: Don't laugh. It's a very serious leg.

greeting: You're my lift? Good. I can walk if somebody's next to me. I just can't walk fast, and I can't walk far.

exchanges.prompt: Lean on me. We'll go slowly.
reply: Slowly I can do. It's the stairs I'm frightened of.

exchanges.prompt: That's set badly. Let me fix the splint first.
reply: Oh, that's much better. Whoever did the first one, don't tell them.
Stepped off a ladder that wasn't there. Long story. Short ladder.

beats.journal: A worker at the <Place> broke his leg. I need to walk him out to the ship.

beats._type: STAND-IN: he follows him; done when they are clear, at the ship. MB82a's ask.
beats.objective: Walk the injured worker out to the ship
beats.journal: I walked an injured worker from the <Place> to a waiting ship, one step at a time.
say: He's aboard. Thank you for going at his pace. Most people don't.

broadcast: He's broken his leg and he won't stop apologising. Walk him out, slowly. We can't spare anyone.
_speech: Fond of him. A stand-in voice; his ear decides.
